title: Replay marker
description: A discontinuity the simulator created itself, published on gt/{unit_id}/marker: a jump to a preset or to an instant, a reset to the start of the data, or the wrap at the end of the data.

kind.description: Which move in the data this marker records.

preset_id.description: The preset the jump came from; absent when the jump named an instant instead.

sim_ts_to.description: The instant the replay continues from.
